source_text:
1.9 Ἵππον μὴ πτοεῖσθαι Καὶ τῷ μὴ πτοεῖσθαι δὲ τοὺς ἵππους μάτην
θεάμασι καινοῖς ἢ σκιαῖς ἄκος ὠτὶ δεξιῷ ζῴου προσαρτηθεῖσα οὐρά, ἢν ζῶντος
αὐτοῦ θηρίου ἀποκοπῇ· κεῖται δὲ ἐν πενταγώνῳ ἑβδόμῳ, ᾧ σημεῖα ὑπερκεῖται
ὑπάτης μέσων, σίγμα καὶ σίγμα.
pass_a_gloss: Horse not to-be-startled. Also for the horses not being-startled in-vain by new sights or shadows a cure is a tail attached to the right ear of the animal, which from the living beast itself was-cut-off; it lies in pentagon 7, to-which signs are-set-above of hypate meson, sigma and sigma.
pass_b_english: That a horse may not be startled. For horses not being startled in vain by new sights or shadows, a cure is a tail attached to the right ear of the animal, cut from the beast while it was living. It lies in pentagon 7, over which are set the signs of hypate meson: sigma and sigma.

choices.english: a tail attached to the right ear of the animal
choices.why: ζῴου is the horse being protected; the tail is cut from a living θηρίον coded in the pentagon, not from the horse itself.
rejected: the animal's own tail on the right ear
a right-ear charm of a living man

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
